newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-DOMINANT AUSTRALIA WIN TEST, SERIES AND ASHES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DOMINANT AUSTRALIA WIN TEST, SERIES AND ASHES.

text.p: Australia completed another demolition of sorry England on Sunday to win the fifth test by 264 runs and with it the six-match series.
Their unbeatable 3-1 lead enabled Australia to retain the Ashes which they have held since 1989.
Facing an unlikely victory target of 451, or the more manageable task of batting for a day and a half for a draw, England were dismissed for 186 in the penultimate over of Sunday's play.

Only Graham Thorpe, unbeaten on 82, showed any real application as England's batsmen fell at regular intervals. There were three wickets each for Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie and Glenn McGrath with Paul Reiffel claiming the other.
Earlier, England's bowlers had also performed badly, allowing Australia to move from their overnight 167 for four to 336 all out.
Ian Healy scored 63 and the tail-enders again found run scoring relatively easy.
